div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
order-orchestration-service
S1 CheckoutSagaService · S3 CancellationSagaService
state: checkout_saga · cancellation_saga · saga_compensation
step key sagaId:STEP · backup sweep 10 s
── only the orchestrator decides ──
start payment only when stock, capacity and slot are all held
re-check payment via GET · compare amounts
confirm resources → then confirm order
on failure compensate only this attempt's resources · Toss compensation cancel if approved
mismatch → RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED · unknown → UNKNOWN_TRACKING
